component.name: Riteed
component.summary: Edit Text, Code, and Config Files

description.p: Riteed is a small GNOME text editor for editing UTF-8 text, code, config, and markdown files.
It provides tabs, search and replace, syntax highlighting, optional line numbers and minimap, and conservative reload prompts when files change on disk.
Added syntax highlighting, an optional minimap, and safer handling for files that change on disk while they are open.
